screensaver.title: Screensaver
screensaver.enabled.sub: Shows up when you leave the PC for a while. Any button closes it.
screensaver.style.paisajes.sub: Slow videos of coasts, mountains and cities. Needs the internet.
screensaver.style.bajo-consumo.sub: Black background and a dim clock. Uses very little power.
screensaver.style.reloj.sub: A big clock on a dark, warm background.
screensaver.weather.show.sub: Temperature and sky, below the clock. In degrees Celsius.
screensaver.loc.autoSub: Worked out from your internet connection.
screensaver.skip.sub: It won’t show up during a full-screen game or video.
screensaver.locateError: Couldn’t work out your location. Choose a city.
screensaver.city.label: City
screensaver.city.none: No city found with that name. Try spelling it another way.
screensaver.city.offline: No connection. Searching for cities needs the internet.
